gloss_en: The seven lamps of the Temple menorah (shiv'at ha-nerot) as a mystical structure — corresponding to the seven orifices of the face (mouth, two nostrils, two eyes, two ears) upon the menorah of the head/brain, and mapped onto the seven clouds of glory, the seven wedding-feast days, and the oil-fed lights whose sanctification draws the surrounding lights (makifin) within
